performance.name: indexed_exact_matching
performance.proof: On representative synthetic populations, EXPLAIN/query instrumentation confirms Customer name, Customer Account Code, Contact name/email and affiliation-scope matching use the declared supporting indexes and do not depend on fuzzy/full-table similarity scans.

performance.name: keyset_list_scaling
performance.proof: Advancing later pages uses opaque keyset predicates on declared sort indexes; ordinary navigation does not use OFFSET proportional to preceding row count.

performance.name: no_n_plus_one_reference_lists
performance.proof: SQL statement count for one list page is bounded independently of number of returned rows; adding rows to a page does not issue one affiliation/channel/Site query per row.

performance.name: bounded_contact_detail
performance.proof: Contact detail returns bounded channel data/count and dedicated cursor continuation; repository never loads all historical/current channels without an explicit bounded page.

performance.name: short_archive_writer_lock
performance.proof: Instrumentation proves ArchiveReference/ReactivateReference call only guard_archive/guard_reactivate while BEGIN IMMEDIATE is held; count/list blocker methods are never invoked under write lock.

performance.name: blocker_scale_independent_commit
performance.proof: Synthetic very-large dependency set increases read-preview pages/count cost but does not cause ArchiveReference commit path to materialize blocker bodies; blocked command rolls back before receipt insertion.

performance.name: preflight_outside_writer
performance.proof: Unicode normalization, email syntax parsing, static field bounds and state-independent setting validation execute before BEGIN IMMEDIATE; instrumentation rejects external I/O/operator waits in state-dependent validation.

security.name: static_sql_surface
security.proof: Repository SQL identifiers are static code; route reference_type/sort/cursor/key inputs pass closed decoding and all values are bound parameters.

security.name: recipient_header_injection
security.proof: CR/LF/NUL/C0-C1 control recipient inputs fail EMAIL_CHANNEL_V1 before persistence/use; no raw failed value reaches generated message headers.

security.name: offline_channel_validation
security.proof: Network call monitor remains zero during Contact channel storage/use validation; no DNS/SMTP/email-service/deliverability request is made.

security.name: history_write_protection
security.proof: Direct SQL attempts to delete masters/history or mutate closed affiliation/superseded identifier/lifecycle-event evidence fail through accepted protection triggers.

security.name: secret_storage_exclusion
security.proof: Ordinary setting/channel/reference APIs reject password, verifier, key, token or device-credential storage paths governed by LLD-12.

security.name: bounded_adversarial_unicode
security.proof: Maximum-bound Unicode normalization/casefold expansion remains within declared memory/output ceilings; oversized input is rejected before unbounded expansion.

rule: These are structural acceptance properties rather than hardware-specific latency thresholds; measured latency tuning may optimize implementation but may not weaken the ownership, boundedness or transaction rules.
